// NOT READY FOR LOCALIZATION
1.0.label = Understanding the Heads Up Display (HUD)
1.1.alert.modal = The Heads-Up-Display provides you with information about your unit and the world around you when you are spawned into the game world.[NL][NL]It contains several elements, including some that are optional. Most of these have been discussed in previous tutorials. 1.1.label = HUD Elements
1.2.alert.modal = The Health bar displays how much life you have. When you are wounded, your health level will decrease. When your health is reduced to zero, you are dead. Watch out for small wounds that slowly continue to bleed causing you to die. 1.2.alert.hilite = health-bar,target 1.2.label = Health Bar
1.3.alert.modal = The Energy bar shows your ability to spend energy by sprinting, crouching, crawling and sprinting. For instance, when the energy bar is at half or less, you cannot sprint. The bar will refill at different rates depending on your activity. 1.3.alert.hilite = atp-bar,target 1.3.label = Energy Bar
1.4.alert.modal = The Chat window is your primary method of communicating with other players. Understanding it is important to your success in Battleground Europe. 1.4.label = Chat Window 1.4.alert.hilite = chatview,target
1.5.alert.modal = The Mini-map can be very useful in combat. It displays friendly units on a mission with the same target, mission target, waypoints, enemy contact reports and other important information. It is always centered on you. To zoom in or out of the mini-map, use {mapin} and {mapout}. 1.5.alert.hilite = kenny,target 1.5.alert1.modal = The bottom of the mini-map shows your Latitude and Longitude in the game world and the name of the closest City. 1.5.alert1.hilite = 894,14,91,31,target 1.5.label = Mini-Map
1.6.alert.modal = One optional element is the Game Information element. This display shows your current Frames Per Second (FPS), Time of Day in the game world, Icon Mode, and your connection's packet stream. You can access this by pressing {showinfo}. 1.6.alert.hilite = gameinfo,target 1.6.label = Game Information
1.7.alert.modal = Another optional element is Vehicle Status. It shows your current persona's rank, and, if you are in a ground vehicle, your current drive gear and any passengers you might have. For aircraft, it shows your G forces (gravities), Angle of Attack, and Slip. Press {showstats} to access this display. 1.7.alert.hilite = readout,target 1.7.label = Vehicle Status
1.8.alert = You can hide the HUD entirely be pressing {changehudmode}. Toggle the HUD off and on again using the {changehudmode} key. 1.8.label = HUD Toggle
1.9.alert.modal = You can rearrange the HUD elements on your screen. Hold {guicursor} down to bring up the mouse and then click and hold your left mouse button to drag that element to a new location. 1.9.alert1 = Move some HUD elements around the screen. When you are ready, press the {resethud} key. This will return your HUD to its default layout. Remember, use {guicursor} to bring up the mouse.[NL][NL]Press the {resethud} key to reset your HUD windows and continue. 1.9.label = Customizing the HUD 1.9.complete.modal = This completes the review of HUD elements.
content.brief: Learn about the Heads Up Display.
content.title: Heads Up Display (HUD)
